_include_note: Scoped to the project's real source roots. It used to be **/*.ts + **/*.tsx from the repo root with only node_modules excluded, which meant ANY stray .tsx anywhere in the working tree entered compilation — an incomplete scratch copy of src/ was enough to fail `tsc --noEmit` for the whole repository, on files that compile cleanly in their real location. This is a scope correction, not a suppression: nothing under a real source root is excluded, and the sandbox .mjs entry point is now checked as well.
